episodeTitle.en: Rapidly test and validate any startup idea with the 2-day Foundation Sprint
episodeTitle.zh: 通过为期两天的基础冲刺，快速测试并验证任何初创想法

guestBioOfficial.en: Jake Knapp and John Zeratsky are the co-creators of the Design Sprint (the famous five-day product innovation process) and authors of the bestselling book Sprint. After decades of working with over 300 startups in the earliest stages, they discovered that most startups fail not because they can’t build, but because they build the wrong thing. The very beginning of a startup is your highest-leverage moment, and most teams waste months or years by skipping a few critical early questions. Jake and John developed the Foundation Sprint to help startups validate ideas and compress months of work into just two days. *What you’ll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰克·纳普（Jake Knapp）和约翰·泽拉特斯基（John Zeratsky）是设计冲刺（著名的五天产品创新流程）的联合创始人，也是畅销书《冲刺》的作者。经过数十年与300多家初创企业的合作，他们发现大多数初创企业失败的原因不是因为无法构建产品，而是因为构建了错误的产品。初创企业的起始阶段是最高效的创新时刻，但大多数团队却因忽略关键早期问题而浪费数月或数年时间。杰克和约翰开发了基础冲刺，帮助初创企业验证创意，将数月工作压缩至仅需两天。*你将学到：*

title.en: Rapidly test and validate any startup idea with the 2-day Foundation Sprint
title.zh: 通过为期两天的基础冲刺，快速测试并验证任何初创想法

summary.en: Jake and JZ present the Foundation Sprint as the missing manual for founders: a roughly two-day, 10-hour sprint where the core team aligns on who the customer is, what they're building, how it differentiates, and how to test it quickly with real prospects. They argue that the more AI-generated a product is, the more generic it becomes—so slowing down to think deeply about what makes it unique actually saves time long-term. Drawing on 300+ teams (Google, Microsoft, Uber, and more), they make the case that two days of focused alignment may be the highest-ROI days in your product's history.
summary.zh: Jake 和 JZ 把“基础冲刺”称作创始人的“缺失手册”：一个约两天、10 小时的冲刺，让核心团队就“客户是谁、在造什么、差异化何在、如何用真实潜客快速验证”达成一致。他们主张：产品越依赖 AI 生成，就越容易变得千篇一律——所以慢下来深度思考“独特之处”长期反而省时间。结合 300 多个团队（Google、Microsoft、Uber 等）的经验，他们认为这两天的聚焦对齐可能是你产品史上投资回报率最高的两天。
